methodology: Isolated synthetic 30-second 320x180 video and independent test database; 12 MiB valid MP4 free atom for multi-range OPFS/IndexedDB checks. Large-file case pads the same synthetic MP4 to 2^31+17 bytes with a valid free atom; this verifies byte offsets and browser disk storage, not 30-minute decoding or remote SSH throughput. Media requests blocked after completion; annotation APIs remain online.
checks: OPFS: full download, local frame pixel equality, offline jumps/play/pause, clear storage, retry and assignment isolation
IndexedDB: full download, local frame pixel equality, offline jumps/play/pause, clear storage, retry and assignment isolation
Pausing an in-flight range and resuming produces a complete playable local file
Quota failure retains online frame viewing and playback
Playback automatically pauses download; pausing playback resumes it; logout releases the complete file
